title: Susan Sarandon, Hannah Einbinder Among 100+ Arrested at Anti-Netanyahu UN Protest - NewsBreak
text:
By James Fortner ,
1 days ago Super Festivals/Wikimedia Commons More than 100 protesters, including high-profile actresses Susan Sarandon and Hannah Einbinder, were detained on September 24, 2026, during a large demonstration outside the United Nations headquarters in New York City. The protest was organized to oppose Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s recent policies and actions amid rising global tensions in the Middle East.
Mass Arrests at Anti-Netanyahu Protest The demonstration drew a diverse crowd of activists, celebrities, and community members critical of Netanyahu’s government. Police reported that over 100 individuals were arrested for civil disobedience, including obstructing traffic and refusing orders to disperse. Both Sarandon and Einbinder were among those taken into custody, sparking widespread media attention and renewed debate over the protest’s message and methods.
Organizers stated that the protest aimed to raise awareness about alleged human rights violations and to call for increased international pressure on Netanyahu’s administration. The arrests occurred peacefully, with no reports of violence on either side.
Celebrities Highlight Political Activism Susan Sarandon, known for her longstanding engagement in political activism, has been vocal about the Israeli-Palestinian conflict for years. Her participation in the protest echoed her calls for justice and accountability. Hannah Einbinder, rising in fame through her work in comedy and television, also used the platform to express solidarity with marginalized communities affected by the conflict.
The involvement of these public figures helped amplify the protest’s visibility, drawing national and international media coverage. Many activists praised their willingness to face arrest as a sign of commitment, while critics argued that the demonstrations could hinder diplomatic efforts.
Context of the Protest Amid Rising Tensions The protest took place amid escalating tensions between Israel and Palestinian territories, with recent military actions drawing condemnation from various global leaders and human rights organizations. Netanyahu’s government has faced significant scrutiny for its policies in the West Bank and Gaza, sparking protests worldwide.
At the United Nations, where the protest was held, diplomats from multiple countries have called for renewed peace talks, though progress remains stalled. The demonstration underscored the deep divisions surrounding the conflict and the challenges faced by international leaders, including President Donald Trump’s administration, in addressing the crisis.
Local Reactions and Broader Implications Though the protest occurred thousands of miles from North Carolina, it resonated with many residents in Wayne and Duplin counties who follow international affairs closely. Local advocacy groups condemned the arrests as an infringement on free speech, while some community members expressed concern over the potential for increased polarization.
The event also sparked conversations about the role of celebrity activism in shaping public opinion and policy. With President Trump’s administration maintaining a strong pro-Israel stance, such protests may influence ongoing debates about U.S. foreign policy in the Middle East.
The detention of over 100 protesters, including prominent figures like Sarandon and Einbinder, highlights the enduring global impact of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict and the complex interplay between activism, diplomacy, and law enforcement in democratic societies.
